compos.summarization:
This smartphone UI screen is titled "Edit Playlist" and allows the user to select various sounds to add to a playlist. The main contents of the screen include a list of sound options, each accompanied by an image and a checkbox. The sounds listed are:

1. App
2. Amazon Jungle
3. Beach Waves Crashing
4. Camp Fire
5. Ocean Waves Crashing
6. Blowing Wind
7. Thunder Storm
8. Rain on Car Roof
9. Rain Storm

At the top of the screen, there are options to go back (indicated by a left arrow) and to save the playlist (indicated by the "SAVE" button). The user can select or deselect sounds by checking or unchecking the corresponding checkboxes.
